facts.fact: The Botswana Communications Regulatory Authority's notice on the Cybersecurity Bill refers to a Botswana National Cybersecurity Strategy that the Bill is meant to implement.
The notice describes a draft Cybersecurity Bill that would enact a Cybersecurity Act and set up a cybersecurity institutional framework, with public consultation on 20 June 2025.
The notice says the draft Cybersecurity Bill is available on the BOCRA website and that written comments go by email to the ministry by 23 June 2025.
The notice announces public consultations on the draft Cybersecurity Bill on 20 June 2025, open to all stakeholders, with comments invited to the ministry by 23 June 2025.
